title: Amount of a Representative's Advance for the Coming Month on an Approved Medical Assistance Case
content:
**Term.** Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, the advance a representative sends for the coming month is the patient pay the coming month will carry less the benefit the resident's funds account applies as representative payee, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent. The advance under this rule is figured for a case in status eligible; for a case in any other status it is nothing.

**The patient pay the coming month will carry** is the patient pay on the County Assistance Office notice in effect for that month:

| Situation on the case | Patient pay the coming month will carry |
|---|---|
| the current notice takes effect on or before the first day of the coming month | the current notice amount |
| the current notice takes effect after the first day of the coming month (a notice with no effective date recorded counts as taking effect after it), and the case carries a notice-basis charge | the amount billed on the latest notice-basis charge, by service month |
| as above, but the case carries no notice-basis charge | the amount of the latest estimate charge, by service month |
| as above, and the case carries no estimate charge either | nothing |

**The resident's funds account** is the resident's account in status active under Resident Trust Fund Accounts, and the funds it applies to an advance are the benefit it applies as representative payee: the latest Social Security benefit, by posting date, received as payee into the resident's funds account, or nothing where none was received.

**How the figures combine.** Figures entering the funds the account applies are combined first, never below zero, and that total is subtracted from the patient pay the coming month will carry; a figure entering the advance itself is added after that; the advance is never below zero and is rounded half up to the cent. Where two records share the latest date a reading goes by, the one posted first is read.

**Hypothetical figures.**

- An eligible case whose current notice of 1,276.90 dollars took effect months ago; the latest benefit received as payee is 1,148.00 dollars. The advance is 1,276.90 less 1,148.00, which is 128.90 dollars.
- The same case with no benefit ever received as payee: the advance is 1,276.90 dollars.
- A benefit of 1,402.00 dollars against the same notice: 1,276.90 less 1,402.00 is below zero, so the advance is zero.
- The same figures on a case in status pending: this rule gives nothing.
